messages:
matt_garcia: Following yesterday's postmortem, opening this thread to lock owners/timelines for alert tuning. We had repeated pages from autoscaling noise and duplicate CPU alerts.

emma_li: Can we list the concrete changes we discussed? I want to own the tracking.

matt_garcia: Short list: 1) collapse duplicate CPU alerts across AZs by hostpool + error_signature; 2) change transient spike rule to require 3/5 windows before paging; 3) add 5m cooldown on autoscale alert during backup windows; 4) adjust paging lanes so infra-ops doesn't get duplicates from infra-oncall.

raj_p: I can take (1) and (4). I'll update the alert matchers to include stack_hash and group_by hostpool, and fix the rotation so only one rotation receives the page. Target: Tue EOD.

emma_li: I'll own (2) transient rule change and doc updates. Plan: implement rolling-window expression and add a regression guard using p99. Due: Mon noon.

oncall-bot: Postmortem ID PMT-2026-0912 linked. Tracker: https://redwood.internal/trackers/pm/0912

matt_garcia: For (3) I'll coordinate with infra to apply suppression during backups. Emma, backup windows are 00:30-01:30 UTC and Wed 03:00-04:00 UTC.

emma_li: Noted. I'll add suppression and a note in the runbook.

raj_p: config snippet I'll apply for dedupe: ```
matchers: ["service:infra","stack_hash:present"]
group_by: ["hostpool","stack_hash"]
dedupe_window: 8m
```

emma_li: For the bucketed rule I'm planning: `count_over_time(rate(requests[1m]) > X)[5m:1m] >= 3` then page. Will add dashboard panels to monitor.

matt_garcia: Putting actions into the tracker now and adding a 72h observation period post-rollout. Success criteria: pages/day down >50% and no increase in user-facing latency.

emma_li: I'll post the dashboard link once panels are ready.

oncall-bot: Actions updated: https://redwood.internal/trackers/alerts/2026-04-tune-sweep

raj_p: Also capturing recurring pattern: "recurring:backup-flap". Monthly review scheduled; owner infra-eng, assignee: emma_li, due: 2026-04-12.

matt_garcia: Thanks all. Use this thread for status updates and rollback notes.

emma_li: Will do. Short and actionable. :thumbsup:
